# Perplexity

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 28 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out AI answer-engine chrome: a sparse left nav, a rounded composer, and a teal accent that shifts from #016a71 in light to #4e99a3 in dark, plus the public hub and pricing pills..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Product home, hub, pricing, enterprise, terms, and a 404 were read. Sign In was opened. Continue with email, Google, Apple, and SSO were not submitted. No card, phone, or Pro checkout.. Themes: light, dark.

Public signed-out surfaces of Perplexity (perplexity.ai), captured on 19 November 2026. The product home at https://www.perplexity.ai/ was read signed out, in light and dark, at 1440 and at 390. The marketing hub, pricing, enterprise, terms, and a missing hub route were read in light. No account was created. No email was submitted. No card or phone was entered.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The page background on the product home computed to `color(srgb 0.984314 0.984314 0.984314)` (`#fbfbfc` if rounded). `--bg-base` on the same element is `#fbfbfb`. The hub body computed to `rgb(250, 248, 245)` while `--bg-base` stayed `#fbfbfb`. The tokens record the custom property, not the body background.

`--sidebar-width` computed to 220px. The painted nav measured 240px. The component token records 240px.

Font weights on the product are 350 and 450 in dark, and 400 and 500 in light, for the same `--font-weight-normal` and `--font-weight-medium` names. Core records the light numbers and names the dark ones in the source string. `light.fontWeight` and `dark.fontWeight` hold each theme.

See a demo over the hub photograph computed to `#dbdee3`. The same label on the light pricing header computed to `#252525`. Both are recorded. Neither is a hover state.

Screenshots are 256-colour PNGs. Read colours from the tokens.

The product heading on the home is 26px. `core.typography.hero` is the authored `--ui-heading-hero` at 46px, which that screen does not use. The hub h1 computed to about 149px, a layout size, not the token.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the teal accent for the product mark and for accent text.** Light accent is `#016a71`. Dark accent is `#4e99a3`. The hub hero and the pricing featured border use the light one. See [hub-light-default.png](screenshots/hub-light-default.png).
- **Use pills for primary actions.** Get started, See a demo, and Continue with Google are 9999px pills. See [button-solid-default.png](components/crops/button-solid-default.png).
- **Keep the composer as a wide rounded shell, not a single-line input.** The signed-out home puts the question in a 20px-radius box. See [text-field-default.png](components/crops/text-field-default.png).
- **Leave the signed-out nav sparse.** It lists the product areas and ends in Sign In. Empty projects and recents stay as empty copy. See [sidebar-default.png](components/crops/sidebar-default.png).
